messages:
maria (Partnerships): Hey team + @jordan, quick sync thread for HelmBridge -> Redwood marketplace listing + joint security integration. We need a short preflight checklist before the partner sandbox run next week.

toni (PM): Agenda: SSO/SAML exchange, SCIM provisioning test, BYO-KMS/HSM handshake, secrets connector smoke tests, and a draft joint announcement embargo.

jordan (HelmBridge): Thanks — from our side we can provide a SAML IdP metadata URL and a staging SCIM endpoint. Planning to use our HSM gateway for KMS operations.

alex (Eng): Can you share SAML metadata + certs in a temp S3 with expiry? Also need OpenID connect fallback details if SAML fails.

jordan (HelmBridge): Uploading now: https://s3.company/example (expires in 48h). Will add OIDC client info by EOD.

sam (Security): Important: we need an IP allowlist for the SCIM callback, and an HSM attestation report (PSA or cert) for BYO-KMS path. Also require Key use policy doc.

lee (SolutionsEng): For the secrets connector, we should validate path conventions. Quick smoke test: create secret X, rotate via HelmBridge API, fetch via Redwood runtime. I'll put commands in a runbook snippet.

alex (Eng): Runbook snippet (staging):
```
# create test secret
curl -X POST https://staging.helmbridge/api/v1/secrets -d '{"name":"rbx-test","value":"s3cret"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
# fetch from Redwood runtime
REDWOOD_KEY=helmbridge://rbx-test node scripts/fetch-secret.js
```

toni (PM): Timelines: internal testing by Tue, partner validation Wed, canary in marketplace Thu. Legal needs embargo dates for joint announcement.

legal-bot: Reminder: Please upload the latest MSA redline to the collaboration folder before partner press. Failure to upload may delay announcement.

jordan (HelmBridge): Noted — legal is looped. We'll push the attestation and MSA redline by EOD tomorrow.

sam (Security): Two blockers I flagged: 1) SCIM bulk provisioning rate limits — need throttling strategy; 2) KMS wrap/unwrap latency SLAs — we need 99th percentile numbers from HelmBridge HSM.

jordan (HelmBridge): 1) We'll expose a /bulk-provision endpoint with rate-limit headers. 2) HSM latency: avg 6ms, p99 28ms (staging), will provide formal metrics.

lee (SolutionsEng): For the rate limit, we'll support Retry-After headers and exponential backoff; I'll add to the connector code.

alex (Eng): Quick infra ask: can we get a staging instance of HelmBridge HSM under our test VPC? Saves bouncing across networks during the smoke run.

jordan (HelmBridge): Yes, can set up a single-tenant staging endpoint (vpn + cert). Need contact & IPs.

maria (Partnerships): Action items I captured:
- Jordan: upload SAML metadata, OIDC fallback, HSM attestation, MSA redline (by EOD tomorrow)
- Alex/Lee: prepare runbook + throttling/backoff support (by Mon morning)
- Sam: define security checklist & IP allowlist template
- Toni: draft embargo dates & announcement outline

maria (Partnerships): If nobody objects I'll schedule a 30-min call Mon 09:30 PT to run through the runbook and smoke test sign-offs. :calendar:

toni (PM): Works for me. I'll send the invite and include a short checklist doc.

alex (Eng): Fine. I'll be on the call with the staging run ready.

jordan (HelmBridge): I'll join — will bring our infra lead.

sam (Security): I'll be there for the checklist sign-off.

lee (SolutionsEng): I'll attach the connector test script to the invite.

maria (Partnerships): Great — one more note: keep the marketplace listing copy minimal until Legal signs off on co-brand language. No external PR until both sides confirm.

jordan (HelmBridge): Understood. Thanks everyone.
